item.title: The Sub-$30,000 Base Nissan Leaf S Has Been Delayed Indefinitely
item.description: Nissan was supposed to launch a more affordable version of the Leaf with a smaller battery and less power this year, but those plans have now been put on hold.

item.title: Lamborghini Cancels Its First EV but Plans to Make the Lanzador a PHEV
item.description: CEO Stephan Winkelmann reportedly said that interest in electric Lamborghinis is 'near zero,' leading the project to be scrapped.

item.title: Driven: 2026 Mazda CX-5 Escalates a Sibling Rivalry
item.description: The redesigned CX-5 moves even closer to the CX-50.

item.title: Next-Gen Chevy Silverado Spied Looking Like Leaked Patent Images
item.description: These new spy photos show more details of Chevy's next-generation half-ton truck, which is getting closer to production.

item.title: GM Recalls 44K Full-Size SUVs Because the Rear Wheels Could Lock Up
item.description: The Tahoe, Suburban, Escalade, and Yukon are all part of a recall related to a control valve located within the 10-speed automatic transmission.

item.title: Over a Dozen Vintage Fire Trucks Are up for Auction with No Reserve
item.description: If you've ever fantasized about being a firefighter, the RM Sotheby's auction of the American LaFrance Corporate Collection is worth a look.
